title: Improve first-run documentation for new developers
summary: Documentation improvements make BCQuality more accessible to new developers by clarifying three usage modes, simplifying the quick start, adding example findings with guidance, and updating plugin versions to 1.8.0.
key_points: Added an overview of three ways to use BCQuality: on-demand plugin review, AL-Go pull-request review (in progress) and plan guidance (preview)
Reworked the quick start into three steps and removed the five-minute time claim
Added an illustrative finding linked to real guidance and a copyable plan guidance prompt
Moved adapter, Entry and coordinator internals from the README to skills/README.md
Set plugin and marketplace versions to 1.8.0; no knowledge, schema or runtime contract changes
quote: Makes BCQuality easier for new developers to understand and get value from, ahead of Directions EMEA.
